title: Roots in Vadnagar
description: Born and raised in Vadnagar, Gujarat. Early exposure to service and community through family and local organizations.

title: Dedicated Pracharak
description: Served as a full-time campaigner (Pracharak) for the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS), traveling extensively across Gujarat to understand grassroots issues.

title: Organizational Architect
description: Transitioned to the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP). Played a key role in organizing campaigns like the Ram Rath Yatra and Ekta Yatra, establishing a strong party cadre in Gujarat.

title: National General Secretary
description: Moved to New Delhi to handle key responsibilities in the central BJP organization, overseeing operations and state elections in several Indian states.

title: Transforming Gujarat
description: Appointed Chief Minister of Gujarat. Led the state's recovery from the Bhuj earthquake and initiated rapid industrial and infrastructural growth through policies like Vibrant Gujarat.

title: Sabka Saath, Sabka Vikas
description: Sworn in as the Prime Minister of India. Launched major national initiatives such as Swachh Bharat Abhiyan, Jan Dhan Yojana, and Make in India.

title: Decisive Mandate & Reforms
description: Re-elected with a larger mandate. Focused on self-reliance (Aatmanirbhar Bharat), abrogation of Article 370, and managing the COVID-19 pandemic.

title: Vision Viksit Bharat 2047
description: Leading India towards the vision of becoming a developed nation by 2047, focusing on technology, infrastructure, and inclusive growth in his historic third term.
